description: Record the app for a while: every shared value (also ones that mount mid-recording), both threads' frame rates and long frames, animations with call sites and stacks, React commits with why components rendered, JS tasks (handlers, effects, timers) and UI-thread worklet time. A person interacts with the app meanwhile (or pass replay: true). Returns the problems found, ranked, each with where it is written and how to fix it. It blocks for durationMs: when you drive the app yourself with another tool (Argent, agent-device, a Maestro flow), use start_recording and stop_recording instead. Prefer run_scenario when the app registered one for the interaction: it is reproducible, so a fix can be checked with compare.

durationMs.description: How long to record, in ms. Default 4000, at most 60000.

replay.description: Run the app's registered replay once recording starts.

signals.description: Names or ids of shared values. Omit to record all of them, including ones that mount while recording.

name: record
